reviews.t: If you wear a size 9.5 or above look at another brand!!
reviews.x: I was very excited to try this product.  I wear a size 9.5 or 10 shoe.  The booties are to go up to shoe size 12 - so I was very surprised to find the booties were Short  on my feet.  I Googled to see how long in inches a size 10 shoe is - it is 10 1/4 inches.  A size 9.5 is 10 1/8 inches long.  A size 12 shoe is 10 7/8 inches.  The Bootie was so short on my feet I felt like toes were going to double under my foot.  After wearing the booties for the 90 minutes I took them off and measured them.

reviews.t: I wanted this to work so bad
reviews.x: I'll start by saying it arrived very quickly, the  instructions are very clear, and the company very helpful. My low rating is simply because it didn't work for me. I followed all directions to a T I soaked my feet before and everyday after the application and yes my feet did peel mostly on the top and around my toes. I expected a lot more my heels and arches were left in the same condition as before.  Did it work for me? Not really but I will definitely give it at least one more try

reviews.t: that was awesome. I was so excited to try them
reviews.x: My Silky Smooth booties arrived well before the target date for shipping, that was awesome. I was so excited to try them. I followed all the detailed instructions for optimal results. After 2-3 days, I started to worry it was a flop. By day 4, my feet were peeling like crazy!!! I had skin sloughing off that I didnt even realize was dead. There has been no pain or discomfort, and mt feet are starting to reveal beautiful and new, smooth skin. Definitely will be using these again!!

reviews.t: Be patient....but it works!
reviews.x: All I can say is be patient. I used this product on a Monday evening. All week long, nothing. I was beginning to think that I had wasted my money. And then Friday got here, and wow! I'm shedding like a snake! LOL Seriously, dry, dead skin is sloughing off like crazy, and the harder, thicker parts are gradually coming off, too.  The moral of the story here....be patient. It may take several days, but it does work!

reviews.t: I liked it, it did peel the dead skin but ...

claims.text: Many reviewers report the product works, with dead skin peeling off within a few days of use.
Some reviewers say the product did not work for them, with no peeling or exfoliation occurring.
Several reviewers find the booties/socks too small, especially for larger foot sizes.
Some reviewers report incomplete results, with hardened or dry skin remaining on heels or soles.
Reviewers praise the customer service and extra gifts received with the order.
